newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APC up on news it raising stake in Piltel.
newsitem.headline: APC up on news it raising stake in Piltel.

text.p: Holding company APC Group Inc rose 10 centavos to 2.24 pesos on Friday at midsession amid heavy trading on news its telecom unit was slowly raising its stake in Pilipino Telephone Corp, analysts said.
APC said Philippine Global Communications (PhilCom) was buying Piltel shares from the market. PhilCom currently holds a slightly more than 20 percent stake in Piltel.
However, Joey Roxas, president of Eagle Equities, said he believed that APC was likely to meet a resistance at 2.30 pesos.
He said the buying, mostly by local investors, baffled him as it would be more logical to buy Piltel since it was the subject of buying.
"The buying in APC defies logic," he said.
Piltel was unchanged at 13.50 pesos by midsession.
